newsitem.title: UK: FIRST USA PRICES $1.4 BILLION TWO-TRANCHE BOND.
newsitem.headline: FIRST USA PRICES $1.4 BILLION TWO-TRANCHE BOND.

text.p: First USA Credit Card Master Trust has priced the two-tranche asset-backed bond for a total of $1.4 billion which was launched on Tuesday, lead manager J.P. Morgan said.
Class A notes total $1.3 billion. It pays a coupon of 6.42 percent, with an issue and reoffer price of 99.762712, to give a spread of 33 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
Class B notes total $117.47 million. It pays a coupon of 6.58 percent with an issue and reoffer price of 99.741120, to give a spread of 50 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
All notes have a legal maturity of March 17, 2005 and an average life of 4.85 years.
The notes will be listed in Luxembourg. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
